title: Even Trees Maximize Every Finite Even-Pattern Count in Rooted Binary Trees
description: Working paper resolving Czabarka–Székely–Wagner's finite binary conjecture: for every n≥k, the even n-leaf tree maximizes the number of leaf-induced copies of the even k-leaf tree. The proof uses an analytic induction and a rigorously finite integer base checked with independent Python and C++ computations. AI-assisted and internally reviewed; not externally peer reviewed.
